parsed.note_claim: Ecevit was informed early on the morning of the 1999 quake, visited the region by helicopter the same day, and gave a statement to TRT, contradicting the claim he went to Yalova 2-3 days later.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Bülent Ecevit ilk gün geldi, 17 Ağustos'ta sabah 6.00-6.30 gibi bölgedeydim. Saat 8.00 gibi de TRT olarak biz canlı yayındaydık. Tam saatini hatırlamıyorum ama öğle saatlerinde Bülent Ecevit Adapazarı'na geldi.
parsed.reason: The Teyit analysis cites period newspapers (Sabah: Ecevit arrived at the PM office early that morning) and TRT reporter Devrim Gürkan's account that Ecevit toured the region by helicopter on Aug 17 and spoke to TRT, directly backing the note.
